## Submission checklist

- [ ] The widget lives in `widgets/<name>/` with a `widget.toml` and a `README.md`.
- [ ] `name` in the manifest equals the directory name.
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally (the gate).
- [ ] `npm run index` was run and the updated `registry/index.json` is committed.
- [ ] The `description` accurately reflects what the widget shows.
- [ ] I have the right to publish this widget under the SPDX `license` declared in `widget.toml`.

<!-- CI re-runs the gate and verifies the committed index is current. -->
